title: Cohomology of integral perfect local models is completed-constant constructible
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and selected uniformizer $\pi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, put $A=\operatorname{ULift}(R)$ and $I=(\operatorname{ULift}(\pi))\subseteq A$, and let $B=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/I^n)_X$ be the actual completed coefficient ring sheaf on the pro-étale site of $X$ [det-prop-integral-criterion-constant-coefficients]. If $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B))$ has stratified perfect coefficient models [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data], then for every $q\in\mathbf Z$ the sheaf $H^q(K)$ has completed-constant stratified finitely presented scalar models [def-sfb-completed-constant-stratified]. No global boundedness assumption is needed.

from.place: Proof, first sentence invoking sk-prop-integral-criterion: reverse local-model argument in Proposition 6.8.11(3), using exact realization and finite presentation of scalar cohomology.

proof.text: The coefficient specialization supplies Noetherianity. In each finite-projective scalar complex, the cycles are a submodule of a finite term and homology is their quotient. Thus homology is finite, hence finitely presented over the Noetherian coefficient ring.

The completed-constant reduction theorem supplies flatness of the completed ring over the constant ring. Tensor symmetry identifies the underlying additive sheaf of the specified scalar extension with that of tensor by this flat module; its naturality follows on pure tensors. The exact conservative additive-sheaf forgetful functors therefore give completedConstantChange_exact. Exact constant realization and this scalar extension commute with homology, proving the canonical completed-model homology isomorphism.

Inverse-image module pullback and slice restriction are exact. Tensor extension along the identity ring map is canonically the identity, so their cohomology comparison is for the actual inverse-image modules used by IsCompletedConstantStratified. Apply it to each given local derived-model isomorphism, then compose with completed-model cohomology comparison. Retain the finite strata and sieves, using the finitely presented module H^q(P) as local scalar model. No coefficient-ring identification on the stratum is needed, because both sides retain the same actual inverse-image ring.

proof_origin.note: V4 formalizes the cited proof using existing exact-functor and perfect-triangle APIs; all new declarations are proved.

theorem integral_perfect_cohomology_completed_constant
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (K : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X
      (adicLisseCompletedRing X (ProEtale.IntegralConstantCompletion.ideal l E))))
    (hK : IsSfbStratifiedPerfect X (ProEtale.IntegralConstantCompletion.ideal l E) K)
    (q : ℤ) :
    IsCompletedConstantStratified X (ProEtale.IntegralConstantCompletion.ideal l E)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K)
